content.title: ‘The White Lotus’ Season 4 Adds Heather Graham, Rosie Perez and Four Others to Cast
content.text: Skip to main content site categories Home TV TV News ‘The White Lotus’ Season 4 Adds Heather Graham, Rosie Perez and Four Others to Cast Frida Gustavsson, Tobias Santelmann, Ben Schnetzer and Laura Smet — you've also won a luxurious trip to France. Heather Graham and Rosie Perez Ben Ritter; Rob Northway The White Lotus France might be running out of rooms. On Monday, HBO revealed that Heather Graham, Frida Gustavsson, Rosie Perez, Tobias Santelmann, Ben Schnetzer and Laura Smet have been cast in the fourth season of Mike White’s The White Lotus. They join an existing cast of 18 White Lotus resort guests — now 24 — and somehow casting is “still ongoing,” per HBO. The White Lotus season four will film in France, and follow a whole new crop of (wealthy) guests on a weeklong vacation. Someone is probably going to die. Related Stories The previously announced season four cast includes Chloe Bennet, Sandra Bernhard, Helena Bonham Carter, Vincent Cassel, Steve Coogan, Caleb Jonte Edwards, Dylan Ennis, Corentin Fila, Ari Graynor, Max Greenfield, Charlie Hall, Marissa Long, Alexander Ludwig, Chris Messina, AJ Michalka, Kumail Nanjiani, Jarrad Paul and Nadia Tereszkiewicz. Season four of The White Lotus is written and directed by White, who solely created the series (in-between Survivor stints, probably) and is executive produced by White, David Bernad and Mark Kamine. White had previously hinted that for this forthcoming season, he aimed to get away from the “crashing waves” settings of seasons one through three. The Hollywood Reporter went deep on season three of the hit and critically-acclaimed HBO drama, including an uncensored history and interviews with the entire cast; read our cover story here. Graham (They Will Kill You, Chosen Family) is repped by Risa Shapiro at RMS Productions, Paradigm, and Morris Yorn, Levine, Barnes, Krintzman, Rubenstein, Kohner, Endlich, Goodell & Gellman. Perez (The Flight Attendant, Your Honor) is repped by Innovative, Strand Entertainment, Meyer and Down, and Vision PR. Gustavsson (Faithless, Vikings: Valhalla) is repped by Actors in Scandinavia, Hamilton Hodell. Santelmann (Detective Hole, The Last Kingdom) is repped by Salomonsson Agency, United Talent Agency. Schnetzer (The Madison, Y: The Last Man) is repped by Gersh, David Weber and Lon Sorenson. Smet (Eager Bodies, The Bridesmaid) is repped by Time Art.
